terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Last update: August 2026
terms.metaDescription: The terms wey dey guide how you go use SentinelX Esports platform.
terms.s1P1: SentinelX Esports na mobile esports platform wey Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke dey run (“we”, “us”, “our”). We dey based for Nigeria and our platform dey available for sentinelxesports.com.
terms.s1P2: If you create account or use any part of SentinelX, e mean say you don agree to dis Terms of Service. If you no agree, abeg no use di platform.
terms.s2Heading: 2. Wetin You Need Before You Fit Join
terms.s2P1: You must don reach 13 years before you fit create account. If you no reach 18, you don confam say your parent or guardian give you permission to use di platform. Players wey no reach 18 no fit withdraw prize money without say their parent or guardian confam am well well.
terms.s2P2: You fit get one account only. If you create plenty accounts to cheat, dem go permanently ban you.
terms.s3P1: Na your work to keep your login details safe. No share your password with anybody. Anything wey happen for your account, na you dey responsible for am.
terms.s3P2: If you feel say person don enter your account, contact us sharp sharp for <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
terms.s4P1: Every tournament get entry fee wey dem go show you clearly before you register. Right now, standard fee na ₦500. If you register and complete payment, e mean say you don confam say you wan play.
terms.s4P2: Paystack dey process entry fee safely. We no dey keep your card details.
terms.s4P3: You fit use SX Coins to reduce or waive entry fee where dem allow am. Check our Refund Policy to see how cancellation dey work.
terms.s5Intro: Every player must play straight. Dis ones no dey allowed:
terms.s5List:
• To submit fake or manipulated match result
  • To use outside tools, scripts, or exploit to get advantage
  • To gang up with your opponent to fix result
  • To threaten, harass, or abuse your opponent
terms.s5P2: You must submit match result with evidence (screenshot and screen recording). Wetin admin decide for disputed result, na im be final.
terms.s5P3: No-show — wey mean say you no show up for your match without notice — go make you forfeit and lose SX Score.
terms.s6P1: Prize money dey enter di bank account wey you link to your player dashboard through Paystack. You must complete identity verification before your first withdrawal.
terms.s6P2: We dey try process approved withdrawal within 1–5 business days. If your bank delay am, na dem cause am, no be us.
terms.s7P1: SX Coins na virtual currency wey dey inside di platform. You go earn am as you dey play and spend time for di platform. SX Coins no get any cash value and you no fit change am to money. You fit use am inside di platform for entry fee discount, community features, and di in-platform store.
terms.s8P1: Gaming Exchange (wey Zolarux escrow dey power) make players fit buy and sell gaming accounts and in-game items. SentinelX dey provide di platform and escrow infrastructure. We no be part of di transaction between buyer and seller and we no dey responsible for any dispute wey come from transaction wey happen outside di platform escrow system.
terms.s9P1: You agree to respect every other member of SentinelX community. Hate speech, discrimination, threat, and harassment no get space here — e go cause suspension or permanent ban. Check our Community Rules to see di full standards.
terms.s10P1: All SentinelX branding, design, and original content na SentinelX Esports property. You no fit copy or share our content without written permission. Content wey you post (match screenshots, community posts) still remain yours, but you dey give us licence to show am for di platform.
terms.s11P1: SentinelX Esports no dey liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential loss wey come from how you dey use di platform. Di total wey we fit owe you for any claim no go pass di total entry fee wey you don pay us for di last 3 months before di claim.
terms.s11P2: We no dey guarantee say platform go dey up 24/7. We go try our best to restore service quick quick if downtime happen.
terms.s12P1: We fit update dis Terms anytime. We go notify you through di platform or email if any major change happen. If you still dey use SentinelX after we post di changes, e mean say you don accept di new terms.
terms.s13P1: Dis Terms dey follow di law of Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any dispute go dey under Nigerian court jurisdiction.
terms.s14P1: You get question about dis Terms? Email us for <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> or message us for WhatsApp: <whatsapp>+234 903 239 5685</whatsapp>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last update: August 2026 · E dey follow Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA)
privacy.metaDescription: How SentinelX Esports dey collect, use, and protect your personal data under Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
privacy.s1P1: SentinelX Esports, wey Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke dey run, na di data controller for personal information wey dis platform dey collect. Contact: <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
privacy.s2AccountList:
• Email address
  • Username and display name
  • Country
  • Password (we dey store am as secure hash — we never see your real password)
privacy.s2ProfileList:
• WhatsApp phone number (optional — we dey use am only for match notification if you opt in)
  • Profile photo
  • Bio
privacy.s2TournamentList:
• Payment information (Paystack dey process am — we dey receive transaction reference, no be your card details)
  • Bank account details (Paystack dey collect am for prize withdrawal — Paystack dey store am, no be us)
privacy.s2PlayList:
• Match history, score, and result
  • SX Score and ranking
  • Achievement and SX Coins balance
  • Match screenshot and recording wey you submit for result verification
privacy.s2AutoList:
• Log data (IP address, browser type, pages wey you visit) — we dey use am for security and to fix bugs
  • Session cookies (na im make login work)
privacy.s3Heading: 3. Why We Dey Use Your Data

account.purpose: To run your account and di platform

whatsapp.basis: Consent — you opt in wen you add your phone number

privacy.s4Heading: 4. Who We Dey Share Your Data With
privacy.s4Intro: We only dey share data where e necessary:
privacy.s4List:
• Paystack — payment processing and bank account verification for prize payout
  • Supabase — database and authentication infrastructure (servers fit dey outside Nigeria; Supabase Inc. dey follow correct data transfer safeguard)
  • Vercel — web hosting
  • Termii (wen e dey active) — WhatsApp notification delivery, only for players wey add phone number
  • Firebase / Google — push notification delivery (FCM)
privacy.s4P2: We no dey sell your personal data. We no dey share am with advertisers.
privacy.s4P3: We fit disclose data to Nigerian law enforcement or regulatory bodies if law require am.
privacy.s5P1: Your username, display name, country, profile photo, SX Score, match history, and achievement dey visible to everybody wey visit di platform. Dis one necessary because of how di platform competitive and community nature be. You fit update your display name and photo anytime for Settings.
privacy.s6Intro: As data subject, you get right to:
privacy.s6List:
• Access — ask for copy of di personal data wey we hold about you
  • Rectification — ask us to correct wrong data
  • Erasure — ask us to delete your account and personal data
  • Restriction — ask us to limit how we dey process your data
  • Portability — collect your data for structured, machine-readable format
  • Objection — object to processing wey dey based on legitimate interest
  • Withdraw consent — remove your WhatsApp number or turn off notification anytime for Settings
privacy.s6P2: To use any of dis rights, email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. We go respond within 30 days.
privacy.s6P3: You still get right to file complaint with Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) for <link>ndpc.gov.ng</link>.
privacy.s7P1: We dey keep your account data as long as your account still active. If you delete your account, we go erase your personal data within 30 days, except law force us to keep am (example, payment records fit stay till 7 years for tax and financial compliance).
privacy.s7P2: Match records and results fit remain for anonymised form for platform statistics.
privacy.s8P1: We dey use industry-standard security measures like encrypted connection (HTTPS), hashed password, and role-based access control. No system dey perfectly secure — if you feel say person don enter your account, contact us sharp sharp.
privacy.s9P1: Players wey no reach 18 fit use di platform if their parent consent. We no dey knowingly collect data from children wey no reach 13. If we notice say child wey no reach 13 create account, we go delete am.
privacy.s10P1: We go notify you through di platform or email if we make any major change to dis policy. Di latest version dey always available for sentinelxesports.com/privacy.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.subtitle: Last update: August 2026
refundPolicy.metaDescription: Wen tournament entry fee, coin discount, and prize money fit refund and wen dem no fit refund.
refundPolicy.s1P1: Entry fee no dey refundable once dem confam your registration and tournament don start.
refundPolicy.s1RefundIntro: You go get full refund if:
refundPolicy.s1RefundList:
• SentinelX cancel di tournament before e start
  • Admin reject your registration before dem publish di bracket
  • Technical error for our platform stop you from playing
refundPolicy.s1NoRefundIntro: You no go get refund if:
refundPolicy.s1NoRefundList:
• You no-show for your scheduled match
  • Dem disqualify you for rule violation after tournament don start
  • You change your mind after dem publish di bracket
refundPolicy.s1P2: Refund dey process through di original payment method and e dey normally take 3–7 business days to show.
refundPolicy.s2Heading: Entry Fee Discount Wey Use SX Coins
refundPolicy.s2Intro: If you use SX Coins to reduce or waive your entry fee:
refundPolicy.s2List:
• Di coin portion go refund as coins (no be naira) if qualifying cancellation happen
  • Coins go enter back your balance immediately after refund
refundPolicy.s3P1: Prize money dey enter your linked bank account after admin approve am. Once dem approve am, payout no fit reverse. If you feel say dem calculate prize wrong, contact us within 7 days after dem confam di result.
refundPolicy.s4P1: SX Coins na virtual currency wey you dey earn through platform activity. Dem no get cash value and dem no dey refundable. If dem close your account because of serious rule violation, you go lose your coins.
refundPolicy.s5P1: Email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> with your username, tournament name, and di reason for your request. We go respond within 3 business days.

rules.title: Tournament Rules
rules.metaDescription: Eligibility, match, result-submission, dispute, and conduct rules wey apply to every SentinelX tournament.
rules.eligibilityList:
• You must get registered and verified SentinelX account
  • You must pay entry fee (₦500 or reduced with SX Coins) before registration deadline
  • Players wey dey serve active suspension no fit enter
rules.beforeList:
• Registration go close before dem generate di bracket — you no fit register after deadline
  • Check your fixture (your scheduled match) for your Player Dashboard after dem publish di bracket
  • Dey online and ready 15 minutes before your scheduled match time
rules.playingList:
• Matches dey play on di agreed game and platform (DLS, EA FC Mobile, eFootball, etc.) as e dey inside di tournament details
  • Both players must enter di match lobby at di scheduled time
  • If you no fit find your opponent after you wait 10 minutes from di scheduled start time, screenshot di empty lobby and submit am as no-show report
rules.submittingList:
• Na di winner get responsibility to submit di result
  • Submit screenshot of di final scoreline AND screen recording of di match
  • You must submit result within 2 hours after di match don end
  • Admin go review and confam di result — di bracket go update only after confam
rules.noShowList:
• If you no show up for your scheduled match, na no-show
  • No-show: your opponent go advance automatically, and you go lose 100 SX Score points
  • If you keep no-show, dem fit suspend you from future tournaments
rules.disputesList:
• If di submitted result wrong, di player wey lose fit raise dispute within 1 hour after submission
  • Admin go review both players' screen recording and take final decision
  • Wetin admin decide for dispute, na im be final
  • If you raise false dispute (wen you dey deliberately contest correct result), you go get SX Score penalty
rules.conductList:
• Respect your opponent — harassment, hate speech, or threat go cause immediate disqualification and suspension
  • Match fixing or collusion na permanent ban offence
  • To use game exploits or outside tools na permanent ban offence
rules.prizesList:
• Prize dey enter di winner wallet after admin confam di final result
  • Players must complete KYC verification before dem withdraw prize money
  • Withdrawal request dey process within 1–5 business days

communityRules.title: Community Rules
communityRules.metaDescription: Di standards wey dey keep SentinelX community positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.intro: SentinelX na Nigeria home of mobile esports. Di community na for everybody wey love di game — we dey keep am positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.basicP1: Treat every member di way wey you go want dem treat you for tournament in person. Behind every username, na real person dey.
communityRules.harassmentP1: No insult, threat, or discrimination based on tribe, religion, gender, region, or any other personal characteristic. Dis one include DMs.
communityRules.spamP1: No repeated posting of di same content, no promotional links without permission, no bot activity.
communityRules.falseInfoP1: No post fake match result, fake screenshot, or misleading claim about other players.
communityRules.privacyP1: No share another player personal information (phone number, address, real name if dem dey use username) without dem consent.
communityRules.cheatingP1: No share or promote methods for cheating for any game wey di platform support.
communityRules.nsfwP1: No explicit, violent, or disturbing content of any kind.
communityRules.consequencesP1:
First offence: Warning
Second offence: Temporary suspension (7–30 days depending on how bad e be)
Serious offences (hate speech, threat, doxxing, cheating): Immediate suspension or permanent ban, no warning need
communityRules.reportingP1: You see something wey break dis rules? Use di report button for any post, or email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. Admin team dey review reports. We dey take every report serious.

safety.title: Stay Safe for SentinelX
safety.metaDescription: How to protect your account, your prize money, and yourself as you dey trade or play for SentinelX.
safety.protectAccountList:
• Use strong, unique password for SentinelX — no reuse am from another app
  • No share your password with anybody, even person wey claim say na SentinelX staff
  • Log out for shared devices after you finish play
  • If your email get reset request wey you no make, change your password sharp sharp and contact us
safety.neverAskHeading: We No Go Ever Ask You For Dis
safety.neverAskIntro: SentinelX staff no go ever ask you for your:
safety.neverAskList:
• Password
  • Bank account PIN or BVN
  • Paystack OTP codes
  • Payment to “unlock” prize money
safety.neverAskP2: If anybody wey claim say na SentinelX ask you for any of dis ones, na scam. Report am to us sharp sharp.
safety.protectPrizeList:
• Only link your own bank account for withdrawal
  • Verify your account before your first withdrawal — dis one dey protect you
  • Prize withdrawal na only through platform dashboard e dey go. Anybody wey ask you to send money first to “unlock” winnings na scammer
safety.safeTradingHeading: How to Trade Safe for Exchange
safety.safeTradingList:
• Always use Zolarux Escrow system for every trade. Money wey dey inside escrow dey protected until both parties confam di transaction
  • No ever agree to complete trade outside di platform — if buyer or seller ask you to go outside escrow, refuse am and report am
  • If deal too sweet to be true, e probably no be true
safety.matchSafetyList:
• Record your screen for every match — dis na your protection if dispute happen for result
  • Keep your recordings until after dem officially confam di result for di platform
  • If your opponent dey abuse you or threaten you, screenshot am and report through di platform or email us
